summary: Elme Communities filed an 8-K on 2026-11-06 disclosing completion of its Plan of Sale and Liquidation, approved by the Board on 2025-07-30 and shareholders on 2025-10-30. At the 11:59 a.m. Effective Time, remaining assets and liabilities transferred to the Elme Communities Liquidating Trust, common shares were cancelled, and shareholders received pro-rata non-transferable beneficial interests in the trust on a 1:1 ownership basis as of the 2025-11-05 book closure. No exchange listing remains; a Form 15 will deregister the shares. Trustees are CEO Paul T. McDermott and CFO W. Drew Hammond. Watch trust distributions and residual-asset realization timing.
